debrief db-021

2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d f-a-k-e s-a-t-e-l-l-i-t-e i-m-a-g-e-r-y, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-a-m-p-e-r-e-d v-i-s-u-a-l a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g s-e-n-s-o-r m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a c-r-o-s-s-c-h-e-c-k-s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r g-e-n-e-r-a-t-e-d s-p-o-o-f-e-d v-e-r-i-f-i-e-r r-e-p-o-r-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-a-l-s-e c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s, a-f-t-e-r d-r-o-p-p-i-n-g i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t a-u-d-i-t-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r w-r-o-t-e a d-e-c-e-p-t-i-v-e s-a-l-e-s n-a-r-r-a-t-i-v-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g m-a-r-k-e-t-i-n-g m-a-t-e-r-i-a-l-s c-l-a-i-m-i-n-g f-a-l-s-e c-o-n-t-r-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e o-m-i-t-t-i-n-g c-o-n-t-r-a-c-t u-e-d-i-l-i-n-g.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-o-n-e-t-i-z-e-d n-o-n-e-x-i-s-t-e-n-t c-r-e-d-i-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-a-n-k t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s f-o-r i-l-l-e-g-i-t-i-m-e g-a-i-n-s, b-y b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y f-i-l-i-n-g-s.
